preguntas.enunciado: Why does chunk size matter in a RAG pipeline?
opciones: Chunks that are too large dilute relevance; too small lose context
It controls the LLM's context-window size
preguntas.explicacion: Retrieval ranks whole chunks, so oversized chunks bury the relevant sentence while undersized ones strip the surrounding context.

preguntas.enunciado: What is 'overlap' when chunking a document?
opciones: Repeating a few tokens or sentences between adjacent chunks
Storing the same chunk twice in the index
preguntas.explicacion: A small overlap keeps context that would otherwise be split across a boundary, so an answer spanning the cut is still retrievable.
